description.content: Posts a successful Emerge Snapshots GitHub check for a given commit SHA, allowing the PR to merge without running a snapshot comparison. The check will show as completed with a note that it was skipped by the user. This is especially useful in monorepos where the snapshot status check is required but a given PR doesn't include any snapshot-relevant changes.

Returns snapshot comparison data between two builds (head and base), including added, removed, changed, and unchanged snapshots. Can also return data for a single build if no base is specified.

query.description: (Required) The Emerge ID of the head (current) build to compare
The Emerge ID of the base build to compare against. If not provided and head upload has a base_sha, it will be automatically determined.
Set to 'true' to skip comparison and return only head build snapshots
